You can support me at [url=https://ko-fi.com/juanpa98ar]Ko-Fi[/url] or [url=https://buymeacoffee.com/juanpa98ar]BuyMeACoffee[/url]!

[center][font=Georgia][b][size=6][i][u][b][size=6][color=#00ff00][i][u]Sounds of the Valley﻿[/u][/i][/color][/size][/b][/u][/i][/size][/b][/font][/center]

[font=Georgia]
[b][size=4]Based on mod '[/size][/b][b][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2760]SFX Replacement -- Better Tool Sounds and Real Thunder[/url]'.[/size][/b]
[size=4]Easily replace most sounds with improved ones. Contains a wide variety of improved sounds compared to its predecessor.[/size][/font]

[font=Georgia][color=#00ffff][size=5][b]See the 'Videos' tab for a preview of the new sounds and comparisons.[/b][/size][/color][/font]

[list]
[*][i][color=#00ff00][size=4][font=Georgia]The video was updated with all the new content from version 3.0.0 (10/13/2024)[/font][/size][/color][/i][/*]
[*][i][color=#00ff00][size=4][font=Georgia]And it'll stay that way until I have time (09/13/2026) :p[/font][/size][/color][/i][/*]
[*][i][font=Georgia][size=5][i][b][color=#ff0000][u]If you have any problem, don't hesitate to report it.[/u][/color][color=#ff7700] [/color][/b][/i][/size][/font][/i][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia][i]

[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Footstep for all surfaces[/size][/font][/*]

[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Explosion[/size][/font][/*]

[b][i][color=#ff7700][u][size=6]New Ambient Sounds ([/size][size=6]Play after the music ends):[/size][/u][/color][/i][/b] [/font]

[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Rain[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Spring Ambient (Day) - Wide variety of singing birds[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Spring Ambient (Night) -  Crickets and the occasional wolf and owl. It starts to sound in the evenings, even in other seasons, except winter.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Night Time - I still don't know when this music is played. Another variety of night crickets.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Autumn Ambient - Light breeze and birds singing[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Summer Ambient - Birds and other small animals[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Winter Ambient - Strong and constant cold winds[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Ocean - You can feel those waves of the sea.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Pool Ambient - Spa. The more I hear it, the more I see the Pool Rooms.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Ginger Island and jungle[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Frost and Lava Mines[/size][/font][/*]

[/list][b][color=#ff0000][font=Georgia][size=5]
Warning: There is a warning that the mod may contain realistic sounds.[/size][/font][/color][/b]

[b][font=Georgia][i][color=#ff0000][size=5][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4][color=#ffffff]You are free to translate the mod; [/color][color=#ffff00]you don't need to ask my permission[/color][color=#ffffff].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods [/color][color=#00ffff](Recommended)[/color][color=#ffffff].
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there. [/color][/size][/font][/b]

Downloads.Description:
Unzip and install like any other mod. If you like the mod don't forget to hit the 'Endorse' button at the top of this page, it helps me a lot and it's free :D

Be sure to stop by later, you're important to me <3
